rationale: Fresh artifact on the same unit whose plan carries only the three in-scope properties, so that the C1 checker set no longer contains the applied-state assertion the review found outside the accepted scope. The requirement, applicability, prerequisites, identity fields, oracle wording and the driven harness rounds are identical to the reviewed three-property artifact; the difference is that no monitor selects the applied-state event (the harness still prints it). This is the second of the two routes the previous note identified for closing the scope issue, after F2 was judged unnecessary because the scope already excludes execution.
